meta.description: Session export field `position` (and `positionLabel`) come from the gomks builder 3x3 'position' control on the comment/floating toolbar. In the app they describe where the note UI is anchored; for static-site implementation, use them as layout intent for the target element in its container context—see .cursor/rules/aed-editor-session-exports.mdc.
meta.noteKind: Optional per-entry `noteKind` (e.g. `design` from the brush on the floating toolbar) signals a visual/CSS review, distinct from `position` layout intent. See .cursor/rules/aed-editor-session-exports.mdc.

tl.label: top-left
tl.frontEndIntent: Anchor content to the start (block flow: top/left; text: left; flex/grid: start/start).

tc.label: top-center
tc.frontEndIntent: Center along the top band of the block: text-align center and/or full-width block with margin auto; flex: justify center on the row, align start vertically if horizontal layout.

tr.label: top-right
tr.frontEndIntent: End-align on the top band: text-align right; or margin-inline-start auto in flex rows.

ml.label: middle-left
ml.frontEndIntent: Vertically middle row, start edge: in multi-row layouts align-self center with justify-self start; for simple blocks often text-align left with surrounding vertical centering on parent.

mc.label: middle-center
mc.frontEndIntent: Center in both axes in the available container: text-align center for text nodes; display block + width 100% for inline labels; flex/grid: place-items or justify/align center. Prefer the smallest change (often text-align + optional width on the target, not rewiring the whole section).

mr.label: middle-right
mr.frontEndIntent: Vertically middle, trailing edge: text-align right or self-end in flex.

bl.label: bottom-left
bl.frontEndIntent: Bottom band, start: align-self end in column flex, or place in last row grid cell at start.

bc.label: bottom-center
bc.frontEndIntent: Bottom band, centered: text-align center with margin-top auto in flex columns, or last row center in grid.

br.label: bottom-right
br.frontEndIntent: Bottom band, end: text-align right or self-end in last row.
